name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate and split votes
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards the extension of its scope to downstream goods and anti-circumvention measures
part_text: (2b) the following Article is inserted: ‘Article 2b The Commission shall adopt implementing acts specifying conditions under which simplified reporting obligations are to be applied to LDCs. Those simplified reporting obligations shall aim in particular to facilitate the market participation of small and medium operators in LDCs, while maintaining reliable reporting, upholding climate integrity, and paying particular attention to avoiding circumvention. Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 29(2).’;
